top_signals.title: Goldman Sees Room for South Africa Asset Rally on Credit Upgrade
top_signals.summary: Markets are not pricing in the probability of South Africa’s return to investment grade, leaving scope for government bonds, stocks and the rand to rally, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
